versions.changelog:
Initial release of the lobster-training skill with advanced AI image generation and editing abilities.

- Supports text-to-image, image+text-to-image, and style transfer.
- Multiple aspect ratios (1:1, 3:2, 16:9, 21:9, etc.) and resolutions (standard, 2K, 4K).
- Shell script workflow for specifying prompts, models, and output.
- Detailed model list for different aspect ratios and resolutions.
- Includes prompt engineering tips and example command-line usage.
